name: openfinance-mcp
description: Servidor MCP read-only de Open Finance (Brasil) para ChatGPT e Hermes

scripts.wipe: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=process.env.DB_PATH||'./data/finance.db';for(const s of ['','-wal','-shm','-journal'])fs.rmSync(b+s,{force:true});console.log('Banco local apagado (incluindo WAL/SHM).')"
